newsitem.title: USA: NOTICE OF SALE - Washington County SD, Utah.
newsitem.headline: NOTICE OF SALE - Washington County SD, Utah.

text.p: Board of Education of Washington County School District,
(Utah School Bond Guaranty Program), Series May 1, 1997
Sealed bids for the purchase of $19,540,000* General Obligation Refunding Bonds (Utah School Bond Guaranty
Program), Series May 1, 1997 (the Series 1997 Bonds'') of the Board of Education of Washington County School District, Washington County, Utah (the

at the offices of Zions Bank Public Finance, Financial Advisor to the Board. The Series 1997 Bonds will be dated May 1, 1997, issuable in the denomination of $5,000 or any whole multiple thereof, not exceeding the amount of each maturity, and will mature serially on March 1 of each of the years and in the amounts as follows:

Interest will be payable commencing on September 1, 1997, and semiannually thereafter on March 1 and September 1 of each year, at a rate or rates not exceeding five and one- half percent (5.50%) per annum to be fixed at the time the Series 1997 Bonds are sold. The Series 1997 Bonds will be issued in registered form and, when issued, will be

registered in the name of The Depository Trust Company, New York, New York, or its nominee. The Depository Trust Company will act as securities depository for the Series 1997 Bonds. Purchases of beneficial interests in the Series 1997 Bonds will be made in book-entry form only in the denomination of $5,000 or any whole multiple thereof. The Series 1997 Bonds are being offered subject to the approval of legality by Chapman and Cutler, Bond Counsel, and certain other

conditions. Copies of the OFFICIAL NOTICE OF BOND SALE, the OFFICIAL STATEMENT, bid forms and other related information with respect to the Series 1997 Bonds may be obtained from Zions Bank Public Finance, Financial Advisor to the Board, 215 South State Street, Suite 700, Salt Lake City, Utah 84111- 2336, telephone: (801) 524-2100, FAX: (801) 524-2109.
ATTEST: /s/ Bill Sampson Business Administrator, Washington County School District, Washington County, Utah
* The aggregate principal amount of the Series 1997 Bonds and the principal amount thereof maturing on a particular maturity date or maturity dates may be adjusted as
determined by the Board as described in the OFFICIAL NOTICE OF BOND SALE.
